note: First data-contract layer for #501 (Frá/Til), per docs/ai/tasks/ticket-500/approved-prompt-v1.md. Not an app-runtime connection and not a full national place list — four already-selected base points only. No new network call; all fields reused from #499/#493 retained deliverables. `null` + `null_reason` is used wherever this round has no real authority for a field — never a guess.
ids_are_stable_and_not_hagstofa: All four `id` values below are internal stable slugs chosen for this contract. None is a Hagstofa Íslands municipality-merging ID (those merge/split over time and do not identify a road point).
